comment: Two-channel overdrive on one 18x16 stripboard, six MPSA05 and three on-board clipping LEDs selected by a 2P6T rotary. The two 3PDT channel footswitches act as each channel's bypass and are left out; two CLRs, one per channel LED.
uncertain: Black diode at column 2, rows H-K is labelled D4 on the board, while the legend reads 'D1-D3: 3mm red LED's' and 'D3: 1N5817': taken as D4 = 1N5817 (legend typo)
240pF at column 15, rows F-H: printed clearly, unusual value
rows: D1-D3, clipping LEDs on the board
